answer: Locks are published in garden, expire in grove, and mirror lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 24 aliases as a result needs 16 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The per-identity price is 107 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
